name_in_paper: gene expression analysis on Illumina microarrays

evidence.quote: In this study unstimulated PBMC from day of vaccination (day 0) and two and seven days later (day 2, day 7) were thawed and lysed for gene expression analysis on Illumina microarrays.

Analysis of these genes using Gene Set Enrichment Analysis [ 31 – 33 ] (GSEA) and the Database for Annotation, Visualisation and Integrated Discovery [ 34 ] (DAVID) showed an enrichment for gene ontology (GO) terms and gene sets relating to an inflammatory response, positive regulation of the immune response, lysosome and apoptosis ( Table 1) .
